title: Sticker Line Challenge
shareTitle: Sticker Line Challenge ⭐ — Playful Line Tracing
description: Pick a sticker buddy and trace dashed paper ribbons — waves, zigzags, and loops — leaving a trail of mini-stickers behind every careful stroke. A papercraft pre-writing tracing game for ages 5–6.
learningGoals: Follow a line from left to right with controlled movement
Practice curved, zigzag, circular, and loop pre-writing strokes
Build finger control that supports later pencil use
interactionModel: drag a sticker buddy along a dashed paper ribbon with one finger
feedbackModel: Gold star checkpoints pop as the child passes them, the buddy stamps a mini-sticker trail, wandering earns a gentle spoken nudge, and every finished line earns warm praise and a rainbow celebration.
credits: QLOBE Kids contributors; papercraft art generated locally (see ASSETS.md).
